CITI BANK
INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE (INTERNSHIP)
SEPTEMBER 2022
Rushabh Maru TY CE

Timeline
PPT : 6th September
Online Test: 11th September
Technical Interview: 14th September
HR interview: 14th September
PPT
The pre placement talk was very conclusive. They gave us all the
details regarding CITI corp and their culture. It would be
advisable to not skip the PPT since there might be questions
regarding the company in the HR interviews

Online Test
The test was conducted on an AMCAT platform. The test
has a total of 5 sections. You cannot navigate back to
previous questions and also are unable to switch between
sections.
1. CS subjects’ based MCQs (25 Questions in 35 minutes)
MCQs based on stacks, queues, trees, searching, sorting
techniques, PTOs, basic programming questions, OOPS, etc
2. Aptitude (16 Questions in 16 minutes)
MCQs on topics like work and time, probability,
permutations and combinations, percentages, ages, profit,
loss, etc. The only thing is you need to be fast.
3. Logical Reasoning (14 Questions in 14 minutes)
I don’t clearly remember the questions in this section. 
4. Verbal Reasoning (22 Questions in 18 minutes)
Antonyms, synonyms, prepositions, passages, etc. The
questions were easy. It is better to read the passages
thoroughly.

5. Coding section (2 questions in 1 hour)
The first question was to find the GCD of an array of
integers. I was able to code this and all test cases were
passed.
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/gcd-two-array-numbers/
I don't remember the second question but it was related to
the incremental matrix and matrix multiplication. I was able
to pass all the test cases for that question as well.
76 students were shortlisted for the interviews

Technical Interview
The first round of interviews started at 9-30 am and my
interview was scheduled first. All interviews were
conducted on zoom. 
The interviewer then introduced himself and then asked me
for my introduction. After reviewing my introduction and
my resume the interviewer told me he was impressed with
my resume. He then asked me about my projects to which I
confidently explained each one of them. 
He then asked me some therotical questions on DBMS. I
was able to answer most of them correctly.
Note: Always be thorough with your projects.
He also asked me some basic HR questions. and then
concluded the interview.
I was selected in the next round along with 31 students
30 Minutes

Tech + HR Interview
The second interview happened almost an hour after my
technical interview ended. The interviewer introduced
herself and then asked me to introduce myself. She then
asked me a few basic questions about my projects. After
reviewing my projects, she then gave me various
hypothetical situations in the corporate world. I was able to
answer them to her satisfaction. She then asked me if I had
any questions for her. I asked her how her experience at
CITI corp has been so far. It is important to always ask
questions to the interviewer at the end.
The results were announced in the evening and I was one of
the 15 students to be picked for the internship.
30 Minutes

Resources
DSA:
I solved problems from Strivers SDE sheet and 450 DSA
Youtube channels that I liked: Take U Forward, Aditya Verma
(For dynamic programming)
OS:
I referred to questions on the interview bit website and notes that
I had made from the gate smashers youtube channel
DBMS:
I referred to questions on the interview bit website and my 4th-
semester notes.
OOPS:
For OOPS questions I have referred to the interview bit website.
HR questions:
For HR questions I have referred to the interview bit website.
ALL THE BEST!!
